text:
Jaccob Slavin has four assists and no goals in 24 games, and Carolina couldn't care less. Cory Lavalette of the North State Journal watched him against Edmonton on Nov 21 and posted that "Slavin has been absurd tonight", after what he called an unreal breakup of a two-on-one. Sebastian Aho, quoted by Lavalette, put it simply: "But that stuff is just as important, especially to us."

The numbers agree. Evolving-Hockey had him taking chances away at the 99th percentile among defensemen last season against top competition. He's a two-time Lady Byng winner, a 2026 Stanley Cup winner, and a fourth-round pick from 2012 who became one of the best defensive defensemen in the league.

This season Carolina gets 56% of the expected goals with him on at five on five, though the team is a bit better without him, which is the cost of always facing the top lines. His pair with Jalen Chatfield has outscored opponents 16-10.

NHL Edge has his shot at the 95th percentile, so a goal is coming. What to watch: the shutdown matchups. That's where his value lives.
